newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech insurer Pojistovna opens UK office.
newsitem.headline: Czech insurer Pojistovna opens UK office.

text.p: The largest Czech insurer Ceska Pojistovna a.s. will open a representative office in London on Monday, the company said in a statement.
"In this way for the first time in history a Czech insurer will have a presence in one of the most important insurance markets," the statement said.

Pojistovna would offer advice to companies which are operating or intend to operate in the Czech Republic, support risky ventures undertaken by Ceska Pojistovna and strengthen contacts with Czech firms in Britain, it said.
In September, Ceska Pojistovna said it did not expect to post a profit in 1996 and could post a loss after net profits of 413 million crowns last year.
